findings.finding: The company's Q1 Q&A says about ¥1,000m of the ¥1,386m Q1-end backlog books in Q2 and calls the H1 sales guide of ¥1,800m '十分に視野'. Q2 needs ¥1,152m, so only about ¥150m has to come from in-quarter orders. No 業績予想の修正 has been filed before the print, and the company has filed none since listing. H1 most likely lands near the guide, with the FY guide held.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last year H1 sales missed the ¥1,100m guide by 5% (¥1,047m) because orders slipped from Q1 to Q2, and the stock still rose +20.95% (limit-up) on 2025-10-15. The backlog had doubled to ¥1,126m and the FY guide was held. Q1 this year landed 'as planned' and fell -3.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, so it is sized small. It is public, and landing inside the company's own guide is what the market was told to expect. What it adds is the small-miss risk being low: a large miss would need ≥10% on sales or ≥30% on OP, would usually trigger a separate 修正, and none has come. If the market priced a miss, the stock would not have run 30% off its September low into the print.
findings.independence: The backlog and guide numbers come from a second document, the Q1 presentation (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260630584506.pdf), which is from the same issuer on the same day. The absence of any 修正 is checked on kabutan's disclosure list (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=135A).

findings.finding: This name's reaction is seasonal on the profit line. Its three Q2/Q4 prints, the quarters where deliveries and profit concentrate, rose +20.14% (2025-04-15), +20.95% (2025-10-15) and +17.23% (2026-04-15). Its three Q1/Q3 loss-quarter prints fell -19.59%, -9.25% and -3.81%. This is a Q2 print, and the H1 headline will read roughly 3.4x OP year on year (326 vs 95).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The pattern itself is the reaction history: 3 of 3 profit-quarter prints up, 3 of 3 loss-quarter prints down. Release dates are confirmed by the TDnet timestamps listed on kabutan; moves are from Yahoo daily closes.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The pattern is visible to anyone with a chart, and the 30% run since early September may be holders front-running it. The three up-moves came at a 23-30x valuation and at limit, against 52x forward now. It is inference from six events, not a company number, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The 2025-10-28 Q2 Q&A says Q2 was strong because Q1 deliveries slipped into Q2 and summer shutdowns concentrate installations in August (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251028/140120251023577915.pdf). That gives the pattern a structural cause rather than chance.

findings.finding: Last year's Q2 rally rested on a backlog jump from ¥574m to ¥1,126m, flagged in advance by a disclosed ¥250m Suntory Products order on 2025-08-29. This year no order notice has been filed between Q1 and the print. With about ¥1,000m of backlog consumed in Q2, the Q2-end backlog needs about ¥890m of Q2 orders just to match last year's ¥1,126m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The backlog surge accompanied the +20.95% on 2025-10-15. Q1 FY27 backlog rose only 9.3% quarter on quarter (to ¥1,386m) and the stock fell -3.8% on that print.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q2 order intake is unknown until the release and nobody can see it. The absence of an order notice is public but easy to overlook. This is an inference from absence, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The backlog series is on Q1 presentation p.6 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260630584506.pdf). The disclosure list showing no 2026 order notice is at https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=135A.

findings.finding: The margin long is crowded (信用倍率 5.25x), and the stock rose about 30% from ¥3,725 (9/3) to ¥5,410 (10/2) into a print where H1 most likely lands inside a guide the company already published. The setup leaves sellers for a merely in-line print, and the Q1 print this year fell -3.8% on day one and -9.3% by day two.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-07-14 in-line Q1 fell -3.81% next day, with margin longs at 7.86x on 7/17.
findings.why_not_priced: It largely agrees with priced_lean_pct (-0.86), so it is sized small. It is filed because the crowded long only matters if the print is in-line, and that is the most likely outcome given the backlog cover.

baseline_tension: The findings net slightly positive (+0.70), against a mildly negative priced lean (-0.86) and a +10% 20-day run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is H1 at or above the ¥1,800m/¥326m guide, a ~3.4x H1 profit headline, the FY guide held and a Q2-end backlog above last year's ¥1,126m. I looked for an order notice, a revision and a return policy that would confirm it, and found none. The negatives rest on the crowded margin long and the absence of a large-order notice.
